text.en: Most pet owners praise the parlour owners for their warm, patient demeanor, noting they treat pets with genuine affection. Nevertheless, a couple of reviewers were dissatisfied, citing an uncommunicated appointment cancellation and feeling staff were unhelpful with scheduling.

Owners of ragdoll cats and anxious dogs appreciate the gentle, calm approach used during full grooms and claw clipping. Clients emphasize that the groomers show remarkable patience with nervous animals that typically struggle with handling, creating a low-stress environment.

Many customers are delighted with how handsome and fragrant their pets return, praising neat scissor work on tricky coats. However, two reviews expressed disappointment, mentioning an unfinished cut on a dog and suboptimal styling results on long-haired feline coats.

q.en: Does the parlour offer cat grooming services?

a.en: Yes, multiple clients bring cats, including ragdolls, for full grooming, nail clipping, and coat maintenance.

q.en: How does the team handle anxious pets?

a.en: Reviewers note that groomers are patient and gentle, successfully reassuring pets that dislike grooming routines.

q.en: Can owners request specific haircut styles?

a.en: Yes, clients bring reference photos, though one reviewer noted the haircut did not match the requested style.

q.en: Are grooming appointments kept reliably on schedule?

a.en: While most visits run smoothly, one customer reported scheduling confusion and a delayed appointment notice.
